title: T1-T12 coupled rom with rib cage, 400 N follower load (Liebsch 2018)
subcategory: long segment with rib cage, follower load

quantity.name: coupled ROM
quantity.definition: T1-T12 secondary (coupled) rotation at 5 Nm of primary load; median of 8. Coupled motions during flexion/extension were near zero (not extracted).

source.authors: Liebsch C, Graf N, Wilke HJ
source.sample: 8 fresh-frozen human C7-L1 thoracic spines with entire rib cage incl. intercostal muscles (Science Care)

protocol.summary: C7-L1 with entire rib cage; C7 and L1 potted; pure moments 5 Nm in flexion, extension, LB left/right, AR left/right, 1 deg/s, 3.5 cycles; tested first without, then with 400 N follower load (all planes within 10 min).
how_to_simulate: Fix L1; apply 400 N follower load along a path through the estimated ICR of each thoracic vertebra (C7-L1), then pure moments of 5 Nm in each direction
Model full rib cage incl. intercostal muscles
Report T1-T12 rotation (one direction) at 5 Nm and coupled rotations in the other two planes
protocol.notes: Digitised from Figs 3-5 (T1-T12, median with range; only medians extracted - range whiskers not extracted). Text-reported FL changes used as check: flexion -36 %, extension -46 %, LB -72 %/-72 %, AR -26 %/-26 %, NZ LB -73 %/-71 %, coupled extension in LB -67 %/-80 %, coupled AR in LB +18 %/+16 %. Segmental coupled motions (Figs 7-9) not extracted. Authors state full data are in the electronic supplement (not available).

extraction.uncertainty: +/-0.3 deg (pixel measurement at 200 dpi, 5.2 px/deg, bar borders; raster figure)
extraction.check_notes: Bar ends measured on two rows per bar; gridline confusion corrected (Fig 5 FL AR). FL/no-FL ratios agree with text % within ~0.3 deg except extension NZ (-8 % digitised vs -22 % text) and AR->LB right (-27 % vs -36 %).

pass_rule.rule: model within [min,max] of specimens (median as target)

ribcage.intact_structures: entire rib cage incl. sternum, costal cartilage, ribs, intercostal muscles and all ligaments

loading.cycles: 3.5 cycles, 3rd cycle evaluated (3rd-order polynomial fit of hysteresis)
loading.preload: 400 N follower load (40 kg dead weight, cables through lateral screws at estimated ICR of each vertebra, C7-L1)
loading.device: spine tester with gantry and balancing weights; Vicon MX13 12 cameras (<0.1 deg)

shared_sample_with: fe_resection_thoracic.liebsch2020.* (>=6 of 8 donors match by age/height/BMI)
